title: Object comparisons under JBMC and auto --confirm after the regression check takes two closures and given implementations
description: lib/tests/heap.rs's proof tier (9 ignored tests: regression checks over objects made by their constructors, under JBMC and under auto with JBMC's confirmation) at the commit that lets a regression check give the previous version a dependency closure of its own (--before-classpath), give an interface parameter an implementation, compare interface results through accessors and read a given object in --unchanged-unless. Those changes are in the regression harness and in how the previous version's types are named, which every regression check goes through. For the inputs of these tests (no interface parameter, one class path) the harness is meant to be as it was: the scope is parsed and emitted where it was, the previous descriptor is the same with nothing relocated beyond the build, and an object's fields are compared as before. This run checks that under JBMC, which the default run does not start. The same tests are also queued at the previous commit (20261115-173209-object-comparisons-under-jbmc-and-auto-c).
expected: all nine ignored tests of lib/tests/heap.rs pass

resources.notes: lib/tests/costs.json: the nine tests run alone sum to 10060 s, the four longest about 40 min each

steps.name: heap proof tier
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 cargo test --release --test heap -- --ignored
